newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said active trading on the domestic A share markets in Shanghai and Shenzhen helped the rates to stay stable today despite sufficient short-term money supply on the market.
"Securities houses and brokerages borrowed large amount of money on the market to speculate on the A share market, preventing the rates from falling sharply," said one trader.
Traders said there were market expectations that the central bank would cut bank interest rates for the third time this year with inflation falling. Official have declined to comment.
They expect the market rates to move in narrow ranges in the short term. -- Shanghai newsroom (86-21) 6279-7004
